briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF L-005
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- water tower top: (-140, -41), roof
- solar canopy: (53, -56), roof
- storage hall: (-135, 97), indoor
- workshop: (-25, 43), indoor
- control room: (82, 51), indoor
- workcell West: (57, 81), indoor
- site B: (93, -14), outdoor
- water tank: (-91, -106), outdoor
- antenna mast: (-150, 31), outdoor
- south yard: (-25, -79), outdoor
- loading dock: (136, -44), outdoor

Robots:
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 6.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 900 s, including the return to its start.
- A1 (fixed_arm): installed at workcell West and cannot move; it can only work on tasks located at workcell West. Equipment: robotic arm. Mains-powered (no endurance limit).
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1080 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 10 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2580 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1260 s, including the return to its start.
- M2 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 6 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2820 s, including the return to its start.
- M3 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 8 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2700 s, including the return to its start.
- D4 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1140 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 60 s. Needs: camera.
- T2: Tighten the valve at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 180 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T9 is finished.
- T3: Run a thermal scan of south yard. Location: south yard. Duration: 120 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T4: Deliver the sensor box (9 kg) to water tank. Location: water tank. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 9 kg).
- T5: Photograph storage hall for the condition report. Location: storage hall. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera.
- T6: Run a thermal scan of site B. Location: site B. Duration: 180 s. Needs: thermal camera. Deadline: finished by t = 480 s.
- T7: Collect a soil sample (2 kg) at water tank and keep it on board. Location: water tank. Duration: 60 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 2 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 420 s.
- T8: Deliver the replacement filter (10 kg) to workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 10 kg).
- T9: Deliver the first-aid kit (10 kg) to workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 10 kg).
- T10: Tighten the valve at loading dock. Location: loading dock. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 600 s. Can start only after T12 is finished.
- T11: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 180 s. Needs: camera.
- T12: Deliver the pressure gauge (5 kg) to loading dock. Location: loading dock. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 5 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 480 s.
- T13: Deliver the pressure gauge (8 kg) to site B. Location: site B. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 8 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 600 s.
- T14: Deliver the first-aid kit (8 kg) to site B. Location: site B. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 8 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 720 s.
- T15: Run a thermal scan of south yard. Location: south yard. Duration: 210 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T16: Deliver the cable reel (10 kg) to south yard. Location: south yard. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 10 kg).

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Keep at least 1 quadcopter on standby: it must not be given any task.
6. Every task must be finished by t = 1500 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Hi team, here is today's job at the site.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: water tower top (-140, -41, a rooftop); solar canopy (53, -56, a rooftop); storage hall (-135, 97, indoors); workshop (-25, 43, indoors); control room (82, 51, indoors); workcell West (57, 81, indoors); site B (93, -14, outside); water tank (-91, -106, outside); antenna mast (-150, 31, outside); south yard (-25, -79, outside); loading dock (136, -44, outside).

The fleet: D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera, cruises at 6.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 15 minutes of flight time, return trip included. A1 is a robot arm bolted down in workcell West; it can't move but can work on jobs inside workcell West, and it runs on mains power. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 8.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 18 minutes including the flight home. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 10 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 43 minutes including getting back. D3, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera and a thermal camera, cruises at 8 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 21 minutes of flight time, return trip included. M2 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 6 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 47 minutes including getting back. M3 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 8 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 45 minutes including getting back. D4 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 7.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 19 minutes including the flight home.

Jobs:
(T1) Have a look at water tower top - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T2) The valve at workcell West needs tightening - that takes 3 minutes on site but only once the first-aid kit (T9) has arrived.
(T3) Check south yard for hot spots - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T4) Water tank needs the sensor box, which weighs 9 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T5) Document storage hall with pictures - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T6) Do a heat check over site B - that takes 3 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 8 minutes.
(T7) Pick up a soil sample at water tank and keep it on board; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 7 minutes.
(T8) Get the replacement filter (10 kg) over to workcell West - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T9) Drop the first-aid kit off at workcell West; it weighs 10 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T10) The valve at loading dock needs tightening - that takes 3.5 minutes on site but only once the pressure gauge (T12) has arrived and it has to be finished within the first 10 minutes.
(T11) Do a visual check of water tower top - that takes 3 minutes on site.
(T12) Get the pressure gauge (5 kg) over to loading dock - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 8 minutes.
(T13) Site B needs the pressure gauge, which weighs 8 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 10 minutes.
(T14) Get the first-aid kit (8 kg) over to site B - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 12 minutes.
(T15) Do a heat check over south yard - that takes 3.5 minutes on site.
(T16) Drop the cable reel off at south yard; it weighs 10 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.

Keep one quadcopter on standby; don't give it any jobs. Everything has to be wrapped up within 25 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
